Home.body: Dorst /dɔrst/ — thirst in Dutch. We brew the kind of beer we'd genuinely want to drink: bold styles, honest ingredients, no compromise.
Home.storyTitle: Born from two countries, one thirst
Home.storyP1: Dorst — meaning "thirst" in Dutch — was founded in 2017 as a collaboration between Dean and Erwin: a Bulgarian and a Dutchman who shared an obsession with craft beer done right. We brew in Bankya with one simple mission: to make the beers we'd genuinely want to drink ourselves.
Home.storyP2: No shortcuts. No filler adjuncts. Just honest ingredients, bold recipes, and a whale to watch over it all.
Home.venuesBody: Find us on tap and on the shelf at bars and bottle shops across Bulgaria. Each venue is handpicked — they care about what they pour.

About.heading: Our Story
About.sub: Founded by Dean and Erwin in Bankya, 2017.
About.title: Two countries. One thirst.
About.p1: Dorst — meaning "thirst" in Dutch — was founded in 2017 by Dean (Bulgarian) and Erwin (Dutch). They met studying in Oxford, discovered a shared obsession with craft beer, and decided to build a brewery together.
About.p2: The brewery is in Bankya, near Sofia. 4,000+ litres a month. 10 beers in rotation, 20+ styles brewed. Unfiltered, unpasteurised, mostly vegan.
About.p3: No shortcuts. No filler adjuncts. No marketing-speak. Just honest ingredients, deliberate recipes, and a whale to watch over it all.
About.breweryP1: We brew in Bankya, a spa town 18km from Sofia. The water is good. The space is ours. The process is open — we don't hide behind smoke machines or mystique.
About.breweryP2: Every batch is logged, tasted, and adjusted. When a recipe is right, we don't change it. Hippy Shake hasn't changed since 2017. There's been no reason to.
About.mascotP1: The whale isn't a logo. It's a character. Hand-drawn, it appears on every label in a different scene — breaching, winged, swimming through stars. Same whale, different adventure.
About.mascotP2: "Drink well, drink whale!" The tagline is ridiculous on purpose. The whale is the brewery's personality: playful, a little anarchic, entirely itself.
About.tradeBody: Kegs and cans. Self-serve ordering portal at dorst.top/partners

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Dorst beers are sold by Crowbar Ltd (Кроубар ООД), UIC 206445482, registered office: 1 Chervena Stena St., entr. 1, fl. 2, office B-2, Lozenets, 1421 Sofia, Bulgaria, the controller of the personal data described here. For any privacy question or request, write to hello@dorst.bg.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Web-shop orders: your name, email address, optional phone number, delivery address, the products you order, any note you add, and your confirmation that you are 18 or older. Partner portal: your company's EIK, a contact email address and the orders your company places. Every visitor: the IP address of each request, used only to stop abuse.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To accept, deliver and invoice your order (performance of a contract). To keep invoices and accounting records (legal obligation under Bulgarian accounting and tax law). To recognise you as a returning customer so your orders and invoices stay together, and to protect the site against bots and abuse (our legitimate interests). We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: Your customer record
sections.body: When you order through the web shop, we keep a customer record with your name, contact details and address in our order system, so the next order with the same email address is linked to it. Invoices to private persons are issued to "Частен Клиент" (private client) under that record.

sections.title: Who processes it for us
sections.body: Vercel (website hosting and privacy-friendly visit statistics without cookies), Supabase (our order database, hosted in the EU), Resend (order and invoice emails), Cloudflare Turnstile (the bot check at checkout) and Upstash (rate limiting by IP address). Each acts only on our instructions. Where a provider is outside the EU, the transfer is covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Invoices and accounting records: as long as Bulgarian accounting and tax law requires, currently up to 10 years. Your customer record: while you are an active customer and for up to 3 years after your last order, unless the law requires longer. Abuse-prevention data about IP addresses: minutes, not days.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.body: dorst-age-verified remembers that you confirmed you are 18 or older (1 year). A language cookie remembers your language choice. Your cart is kept in your browser's local storage and the partner portal sign-in in session storage; neither is sent to anyone else. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us for access to your data, correction, erasure, restriction of processing, a portable copy, or object to processing based on our legitimate interests. Write to hello@dorst.bg; we answer within one month. Data we must keep for accounting cannot be erased before that period ends. You may also complain to the Commission for Personal Data Protection (КЗЛД), 2 Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov Blvd., Sofia 1592, www.cpdp.bg.
